title: Al-Insan 76:27-31 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y9 lesson 45 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Insan 76:27-31 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 45. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًۭا ثَقِيلًۭا (٢٧) نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا (٢٨) إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًۭا (٢٩) وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًۭا (٣٠) يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا (٣١)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day.
We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.
Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.
And you do not will except that Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise.
He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment.

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Insan 76:27-31 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 76:27-31 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: «إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ»: noon before ي is ...
Listening rota: today's group recites 76:27-31 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Find the three waqf signs in 76:29 to 31.
How do 76:29 and 76:30 together answer the question of choice?
questions.a: We truly choose a way to our Lord (29), yet nothing happens outside Allah's will (30).
A) a reminder (tadhkirah). 76:29: 'Indeed, this is a reminder.'

questions.q: Al-Insan 76:30: «وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: 'You do not will except that Allah wills' (76:30). If Allah wills everything, why do we still have to choose and try?
questions.a: Allah gave us real choice and will judge our choices; His will includes our choosing. We act, and trust Him.
